## Cherry

这是一款主打清爽体验的客户端整合包，专注性能优化与实用辅助。

整合了社区主流的优化模组并已完成预设配置，同时提供多项不影响平衡性的便捷功能。开箱即用，适合追求流畅原版体验的玩家。

## 主要特性

### 性能优化

整合了当前社区主流的优化模组（如钠、锂等），并已完成预设配置。帧数表现、区块加载与整体流畅度相较原版均有明显改善

### 便捷功能

整合了多项不影响游戏平衡性的实用功能，涵盖界面交互、信息显示与日常操作的优化，旨在减少繁琐步骤，提升便利性。

## 更新与反馈

- 更新日志：见更新日志页面
- 问题反馈：通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Cherry-TSL/wikipedia/issues) 提交

## 常见问题

- Q：我是否适合使用此整合包？

  A：对于有自行配置整合包经验的玩家，可根据个人需求决定是否使用。对于希望减少调试成本、追求开箱即用的玩家，Cherry 是合适的选择。

- Q：安装整合包会影响原版游戏体验吗？

  A：不会。所有内容均为叠加式优化与可选功能，不修改原版核心机制，如有需要可随时调整或卸载。

## Cherry

Cherry is a client‑side modpack focused on a clean, lightweight experience, with an emphasis on performance optimization and practical quality‑of‑life features.

It includes mainstream optimization mods from the community, all pre‑configured out of the box, along with several non‑game‑breaking convenience features. It is ready to use and ideal for players who want a smooth, vanilla‑like experience.

## Key Features

### Performance Optimization

Cherry integrates popular optimization mods (such as Sodium and Lithium) with preset configurations. Compared to the vanilla game, you will notice significant improvements in frame rates, chunk loading, and overall smoothness.

### Quality‑of‑Life Enhancements

The pack includes a variety of practical features that do not affect game balance, covering UI interactions, information displays, and daily operations. These are designed to reduce tedious steps and improve convenience.

## Updates & Feedback

- Changelog: See the Changelog page.
- Bug reports / suggestions: Submit via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Cherry-TSL/wikipedia/issues).

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Q: Is this modpack suitable for me?

  A: If you are experienced in configuring your own modpacks, you may decide based on your personal needs. If you prefer to minimise setup time and want a ready‑to‑use experience, Cherry is a good choice.

- Q: Will installing this modpack affect the vanilla game experience?

  A: No. All additions are overlay optimisations and optional features. They do not modify core game mechanics. You can adjust or remove them at any time if needed.
